systems.owner: CNEDOGE (Centro Nacional de Emisión de Documentos Oficiales de Guinea Ecuatorial), Ministerio de la Seguridad Nacional; uploaded documents reviewed by the Policía Nacional
systems.tiers: applicants abroad online; diplomatic missions and consular offices for appointments and biometric capture; personalisation and printing central at CNEDOGE
consulted to check that a passport applicant never held an identity document (DIP); the order does not say whether it is paper or digital

note: No fact: the order of 2022-06-22 sets the procedure for biometric passports applied for abroad. The Policía Nacional appears as reviewer of uploaded applications and keeper of an archive of identity documents; nothing is said of stations recording reports or cases. Art. 15 requires a lost or stolen passport to be reported to the authorities of the jurisdiction, with no means stated; art. 16 has CNEDOGE notify annulments to migration authorities and INTERPOL.
